text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer connected sentences with transitions like \"also,\" \"An Example is,\" and \"Thats why\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"Uses more linking language to connect ideas across sentences and paragraphs."},{"evidence":"clear paragraph breaks around friend and grandma examples","quality":"organization","description":"Presents ideas in more distinct sections with a more evident overall structure."},{"evidence":"\"he has stage 2 cancer\" \"he knows the real meaning of struggle\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"Shows better ability to produce complete, controlled sentences with fewer severe run-ons and fragments."},{"evidence":"\"share wisdom and experience\" \"cooking ability\" \"fully developed\"","quality":"word choice","description":"Uses a wider range of more precise academic and descriptive vocabulary."},{"evidence":"\"I learn something new from her cooking ability\" \"they study or practice a lot\"","quality":"development of ideas","description":"Explains examples more fully and develops the point with more elaboration and reasoning."},{"evidence":"\"I think Learning from the experience of others is better because\"","quality":"argumentative clarity","description":"States the main claim more explicitly and supports it more directly than the other essay."}]}
